messages:
Priya Kapoor: Kickoff for Vermillion Health onboarding — primary ask: private/VPC deployment for PHI workloads. Target go‑live: ~8 weeks. Success criteria I care about: secure network + KMS, baseline p95 latency <200ms (512 tokens), Acceptability >=95% on our evaluation prompts. Stakeholders: Cara (PM), Marco (Eng lead), Jules (Security). Internals: Priya (CS), Derek (Solutions), Anika (Enablement). Can folks confirm owners and whether Monday 10:00am PST works for a 30m alignment?

Derek Liu: I can own infra/network + peering. Need their CIDR, preferred cloud region, and security questionnaire. @Cara can you share network owner? Monday 10 works for me.

Cara (Vermillion): Network owner is Marco but he'll be on call. I'll share CIDR + onboarding packet by EOD. Monday 10am PST works.

Anika Perez: I'll lead enablement and training plan. I need a sandbox service account + a set of 20 acceptance prompts. I'll draft a 2-session training (admins + devs). Will put a first draft of the playbook in the drive before the meeting.

Sam Brooks: Flagging renewal risk note — Vermillion mentioned regulatory audit windows next quarter. If we can't get SSO + audit logs ready before their audit window, they might pause renewal conversations. Recommend we prioritize SSO/KMS auditing items.

Priya Kapoor: Good call Sam — add SSO and audit logs to must-have for first 8 weeks. Derek, can you estimate effort for KMS + audit logs?

Derek Liu: Rough estimate: KMS integration + key policy config ~2 dev days, audit log forwarding + retention 3–4 days depending on their SIEM. I'll scope properly after I see their questionnaire.

Marco (Vermillion): We use GCP, SIEM is Splunk. I can get Jules and our infra engineer DK into the invite.

Jules (Vermillion Sec): We'll need an architecture diagram for VPC peering and a list of required controls (e.g., CMK rotation policy, KMS access list). I'll review once you share the runbook.

OnboardBot: Meeting scheduled: Mon Apr 06 2026 10:00 AM PST — 30 minutes. Reminder set 30 minutes prior.

Priya Kapoor: Quick 30s checklist for the meeting — please react with the owner initials next to each:
```
- NDA signed
- VPC peering/CIDR exchange
- KMS/keys config
- SSO + audit logs
- Acceptance prompts + eval harness run
- Training session 1 (admins)
- Training session 2 (devs)
```

Derek Liu: ✅ VPC peering/CIDR exchange — DL

Anika Perez: ✅ Training sessions & acceptance prompts — AP

Sam Brooks: ✅ NDA + renewal notes — SB

Priya Kapoor: Thanks — I'll follow up with a short agenda and action items doc. Main risk right now: audit timing + SIEM integration. If anyone thinks go‑live <8 weeks is unlikely, call it out now so we can set expectations with the customer.

Cara (Vermillion): On my side, audit window is mid‑May. We should aim to have KMS + basic audit logs by then.

Priya Kapoor: Noted. I'll escalate to Solutions leadership if we need to shift priorities. See you all Monday. :thumbsup:
